title: A Tier-2 city just expanded its metro network - no fanfare, just 11 new stations
sources: GKToday - Indore Metro Priority Corridor-2 Inaugurated
Swarajya Mag - Indore Metro Priority Corridor-2 Inaugurated, Network Expands To 16 Operational Stations Covering Around 17 Km
caption:
A Tier-2 city just expanded its metro network. No fanfare, just 11 new stations.

On September 6, 2026, Indore inaugurated Priority Corridor-2 of its metro - an 11 km stretch with 11 new stations running from Super Corridor-3 to Malviya Nagar Chauraha, built at a cost of roughly Rs 2,850 crore. The expansion pushed Indore Metro's total operational network to roughly 17 km across 16 stations.

Metro rail used to mean Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru. Indore just added itself to that list, one corridor at a time.
